title: Federation draft MUSTs full overdetermination sweep
description:
The federation draft has 83 MUSTs. The post-c93e545 survey caught three findings (uy1m.2 outbox durability, uy1m.3 60s receiveTypingIndicators TTL, uy1m.4 30s outbound presence rate). These were the obvious ones. A full sweep might surface more, especially:

- Peer discovery and /.well-known/jmap interaction rules
- Outbox retry semantics (already-impl-defined at lines 599, 601 but worth confirming nothing else slipped)
- Receipt-sharing inbound suppression edge cases
- Peer/groupUpdate behavior when membership changes mid-flight
- Peer authentication identity-binding rules at lines 130, 145, 151
- Federation MUSTs related to identity verification at lines 246-271

Method: read draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md end-to-end with the same lens as the main-draft survey (Pattern A through E from the earlier work). File any findings as new children under uy1m (Tier 2) or ic5s (Tier 3) as appropriate, or as standalone beads. Close this bead with a summary of what was found (or 'no findings').
acceptance_criteria:
- Federation draft read end-to-end with overdetermination lens
- Each finding has a child bead with file:line citation and recommended fix shape (matching the established Tier 2 / Tier 3 conventions)
- This bead's close-reason summarizes what was found
- 'No findings' is an acceptable outcome and should be stated as such if true (anti-bikeshedding)
